description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Length, which represents a measurable length with a numeric value and a unit, including methods for creation, validation, comparison, and string representation.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Length
classes.description: A class capable of representing, validating, and comparing CSS length units and values.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new HTMLPurifier_Length with a string magnitude and optional unit.

methods.name: make
methods.description: Creates an instance of HTMLPurifier_Length from a string like '2em' or '3.4in'.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the length's value and unit, checking against allowed CSS units.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the length if valid.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the length instance is valid.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this length with another, returning 1, -1, or 0 based on their relative magnitude.
